questions.questionText: The revenue for Nilgiri Tea Co. in 2020-21 is what percent of the revenue for Ganga Papers in 2020-21? (Answer to the nearest integer.)
questions.shortcut: The base is the value after 'of'; put it in the denominator.

questions.questionText: In 2021-22, the combined revenue of Ganga Papers and Nilgiri Tea Co. forms what percent of the total revenue of all companies that financial year? (One decimal place.)
questions.explanation: Ganga Papers + Nilgiri Tea Co. = 1150 + 980 = 2130. Total for 2021-22 = 5,300. Percent = 2130/5,300 × 100 = 40.2%.
questions.shortcut: Add the two numerator cells first; the denominator is the full column total.

questions.questionText: By what percent is the revenue for Kaveri Foods in 2021-22 more than that for Nilgiri Tea Co. in 2021-22? (Correct to one decimal place.)
questions.explanation: Difference = 2200 - 980 = 1220. Percent more = 1220 / 980 × 100 = 124.5% (base is the smaller quantity, Nilgiri Tea Co.).
questions.shortcut: 'More than B' means B is the base: (A - B) / B × 100.

questions.questionText: What percent of the total revenue of Nilgiri Tea Co. over all financial years was recorded in its best financial year? (Correct to one decimal place.)
questions.explanation: Best financial year for Nilgiri Tea Co. is 2023-24 with 1060. Total = 4,710. Percent = 1060/4,710 × 100 = 22.5%.
questions.shortcut: Find the row maximum, then divide by the row total.

questions.questionText: What percent of the total revenue of all companies in 2022-23 is contributed by Himalaya Herbals? (Correct to one decimal place.)
questions.explanation: Total for 2022-23 = 4,910. Share of Himalaya Herbals = 900 / 4,910 × 100 = 18.3%.
questions.shortcut: Total first, then divide: the denominator is the column total, not another single cell.

questions.questionText: What is the ratio of the combined electricity consumption of Indore and Coimbatore in June to the combined electricity consumption of Madurai and Nagpur in September, in simplest form?
questions.explanation: Indore + Coimbatore in June = 180 + 1140 = 1320. Madurai + Nagpur in September = 250 + 730 = 980. Ratio = 1320 : 980 = 66 : 49.
questions.shortcut: Note that the two groups come from different periods; read each from its own column.

questions.questionText: What is the ratio of the electricity consumption for Madurai to that for Coimbatore in September, in its simplest form?
questions.explanation: 250 : 730; dividing both by 10 gives 25 : 73.
